name: Ryoubo-san, Kocchi no Osewa mo Onegai Shimasu! ~Hai, Yorokonde! Acchi no Tairyoku mo Sokonashi Desu ne!!~
original_name: 寮母さん、こっちのお世話もお願いします! ～はい、よろこんで! アッチの体力も底なしですね!!～
source:
Leave all the housework and sexual needs to me!

It's been three years since Kae Numata became the dorm mother at Hinata Dorm. She lives and works alongside around twenty students who pour their energy into academics and club activities every day.

She's a charismatic dorm mother who handles all the housework—cleaning, laundry, cooking, and more. And night after night, she also takes care of the robust sexual needs of the students...!?

“Alright, let's give it our all again today!!”

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt278/apt278.html#link_story]official site[/url]]
